3: > Critical flows for the `configuration` and `governance` bounded contexts inside `app/backend/`. 5: ## 1. Configuration Change Submission and Runtime Execution Freeze Enforcement
6: 
7: ```mermaid
8: sequenceDiagram
9:   participant maker as Operator / Admin Maker (webApp)
10:   participant checker as Approver Checker (webApp)
11:   participant bffApi as BFF & REST API (configuration + governance)
12:   participant relationalDb as PostgreSQL 15
13: 
14:   maker->>bffApi: POST /api/v1/tickets (type=RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH or SCHEDULE_CHANGE, effectiveAt in Asia/Manila, warningAcknowledged=true, Idempotency-Key)
15:   bffApi->>bffApi: Validate Asia/Manila effective_at hour window & cron warning acknowledgment
16:   bffApi->>relationalDb: BEGIN TX; INSERT staged recipe_versions/schedule_configs (DRAFT -> PENDING_PUBLISH); INSERT governance_tickets (status=PENDING_APPROVAL); INSERT audit_log_entries; COMMIT
17:   bffApi-->>maker: 201 Created (ticketId, status=PENDING_APPROVAL)
18: 
19:   checker->>bffApi: POST /api/v1/tickets/{ticketId}/approve (If-Match: version)
20:   bffApi->>relationalDb: BEGIN TX; SELECT governance_tickets, report_definitions FOR UPDATE
21:   bffApi->>bffApi: Verify SoD (checker != maker in prod, no conflicting role)
22:   bffApi->>relationalDb: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report_runs WHERE report_definition_id = targetDefId AND status IN ('JOB_QUEUED', 'RUNNING'))
23:   alt Target definition has active run in JOB_QUEUED or RUNNING (Runtime Execution Freeze)
24:     relationalDb-->>bffApi: true (In-flight run detected)
25:     bffApi->>relationalDb: ROLLBACK status change; INSERT audit_log_entries (outcome=DENIED_EXECUTION_FREEZE)
26:     bffApi-->>checker: 409 Conflict (application/problem+json, errorCode=EXECUTION_FREEZE_ACTIVE, correlationId)
27:   else Zero in-flight runs & effective_at window valid in Asia/Manila
28:     relationalDb-->>bffApi: false (No in-flight runs)
29:     bffApi->>relationalDb: UPDATE old recipe_versions SET lifecycle_status=SUPERSEDED; UPDATE new recipe_versions SET lifecycle_status=ACTIVE; UPDATE report_definitions SET active_recipe_version_id=newId, version=version+1
30:     bffApi->>relationalDb: UPDATE governance_tickets SET status=APPROVED, decided_by_user_id=checkerId, decided_at=now()
31:     bffApi->>relationalDb: INSERT audit_log_entries (with JSON diff) & notification_events; COMMIT
